text: 🚨 Two fires have been spotted burning in the waters near the coasts of Qatar and the UAE.
Israeli Air Force fighters are flying over Damascus, the Syrian capital.
The U.S. Embassy in Bahrain has issued a security warning to Americans about a possible airspace closure amid regional developments.

Houthis have released footage of fights against Yemeni government aligned forces across the Kahbub mountain range.

Targets include the National Army, Southern Giants Brigades and Nation's Shield Forces.

Fire broke out at Russia's Proton Electrotex plant in Oryol after a Ukrainian FP5 Flamingo cruise missile strike.

The plant makes semiconductors and power electronics for Russian weapons and was also hit on 23 October.
Qatar's prime minister is urging Washington and Tehran not to hold out for a "perfect moment" and to reach a deal that ends the war now.

Trump: Israel and the entire Middle East would not exist today if he had not stopped Iran from getting a nuclear weapon.

"Nobody wants to say it, but everyone knows it is true."
Iran has threatened Europe with strikes if the U.S. resumes attacks, naming Italy and Germany as main targets because of their U.S. bases.

Iranian air defenses fired from Qeshm Island toward a U.S. aircraft over the Strait of Hormuz.

There are also unconfirmed reports that a U.S. MQ9A Reaper was shot down.
Seven U.S. aerial refueling tankers are flying near the Strait of Hormuz.

🚨 Trump: "Nothing is going to Iran. No oil is going to Iran."

He says U.S. forces control which vessels can pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

Ukrainian forces are making big gains in the Borova direction, threatening the Russian line along the Oskil river.

Zelenyi Hai is liberated, Vyshneve cleared, and Russian troops pushed back around Bohuslavka and Novoplatonivka.

Putin has shifted his Ukraine strategy to bombing Kyiv into submission at the negotiating table, Kremlin sources tell the FT.

The plan: keep hitting energy, bridges and roads until Ukraine's infrastructure is crippled by next year.
Warplanes have been flying intensively over the Iraqi city of Najaf for hours, local reports say.

British and American C17 military cargo planes have landed in Jordan and Qatar.

Flight tracking shows an RAF C17 arriving at Zarqa and a U.S. Air Force C17 touching down at Al Udeid.
Zelensky says Ukrainian intelligence shows Russia may be preparing a new wave of strikes on the country's energy infrastructure.
A Russian Iskander M ballistic missile carrying a cluster warhead struck Kyiv overnight.

Ukrainian drones struck the Saratov Oil Refinery.

Several Russian military aircraft were moved out of Engels 2 Air Base as more strikes were feared.

Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei asked Putin for S400 air defense systems in a personal letter carried by Mohsen Rezaei, The Telegraph reports.

Moscow may hesitate given its own needs in Ukraine.

The U.S. Treasury has sanctioned eight Canadian currency exchange firms accused of helping Iranian entities dodge sanctions, some by turning rials into crypto.

Washington says Canada must not be a safe haven for the regime's money men.
